title: With nothing ticked, the bulk button cannot open a confirmation
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Deactivate parts.
  3. Hover over Deactivate on the dark bar.
  4. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  5. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on and the bar reads 0 selected.

Step 3:

  • The button is disabled and its hover text reads "Tick the parts to deactivate".

Step 4:

  • No confirmation opens: a change with no parts cannot be sent from the screen.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 1 selected and the Deactivate button is no longer disabled.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-N1: “With nothing ticked, the Deactivate button is visible but disabled, so the confirmation cannot open.”
  • S2-R8: “The Deactivate button is disabled while no row is ticked. Hovering it then shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Deactivate hovered with nothing ticked | "Tick the parts to deactivate" | Tooltip on the disabled button”
